mapper.select: SELECT t.SHPOUT_DT AS shpoutDt, t.DLV_DT AS dlvDt, t.JOB_SEQ AS jobSeq, t.ROW_NO AS rowNo, t.SRC_FILE AS srcFile, CONVERT(varchar(19), t.UPLOAD_DTTM, 120) AS uploadDttm, -- ★firstDttm(같은 품목 최초 업로드일시) — 종전에는 행마다 상관 서브쿼리로 같은 테이블을 다시 뒤졌다. -- 4,562행 조회에서 이 한 칸이 871ms 를 먹었다(944ms → 73ms, 2026-07-25 실측). -- 윈도우 함수로 한 번에 계산한다(=167ms). 파티션 범위는 종전과 동일 — 기간·ACTION_YN 과 무관하게 -- 같은 (출고일자+출고장+사업장+품목)의 전체 최소값이라 아래 t 서브쿼리 안에서 먼저 계산해야 한다. t.firstDttm, t.DC_CD AS dcCd, t.DC_NM AS dcNm, t.VENDOR_CD AS vendorCd, t.VENDOR_NM AS vendorNm, t.ITEM_CD AS itemCd, t.ITEM_NM AS itemNm, t.BIZ_CD AS bizCd, t.BIZ_NM AS bizNm, t.BOX_QTY AS boxQty, t.LABEL_QTY AS labelQty, t.UNPAID_LABEL_QTY AS unpaidLabelQty, t.INWH AS inwh, t.ZONE AS zone, t.BUS_NO AS busNo, t.RT_SEQ AS rtSeq, t.CUR_QTY AS curQty, t.DLV_GB AS dlvGb, t.REMARK AS remark, t.PROD_KIND AS prodKind, t.TEMP_GB AS tempGb, t.ORD_GB AS ordGb, t.UNIT AS unit, t.ORD_NO AS ordNo, t.ORD_ITEM_NO AS ordItemNo, t.JUMUN_NO AS jumunNo, t.JUMUN_ITEM_NO AS jumunItemNo, -- ★판매단가 — 마감관리(selectClosing)와 똑같은 규칙(2026-07-25). 매출내역에서 정산서가 아직 안 온 -- 출고행의 매출금액을 이 단가로 채운다. 기준일은 마감과 같이 납품일자(DLV_DT). u.saleUnit, u.saleSrc FROM ( SELECT s0.*, CONVERT(varchar(19), MIN(s0.UPLOAD_DTTM) OVER (PARTITION BY s0.COMP_CD, s0.SHPOUT_DT, ISNULL(s0.DC_CD,''), ISNULL(s0.BIZ_CD,''), ISNULL(s0.ITEM_CD,'')), 120) AS firstDttm FROM TBL_SHIPOUT_MST s0 -- ★★속도 (2026-08-07 실측) — 이 안쪽 WHERE 가 핵심이다. -- 종전에는 여기가 `FROM TBL_SHIPOUT_MST s0` 뿐이라, 하루치 257건을 보려고 -- **49,933행 전체**에 윈도우 함수를 돌린 뒤 바깥에서 날짜로 걸렀다(810ms). -- ★안전한 이유 : PARTITION BY 에 SHPOUT_DT·COMP_CD 가 이미 들어 있다. -- 다른 날짜/회사 행은 애초에 다른 파티션이라 결과에 영향을 줄 수 없으므로, -- 날짜·회사 조건을 안쪽으로 옮겨도 firstDttm 값이 100% 같다. -- ★ACTION_YN 은 절대 안쪽으로 옮기지 말 것 — 파티션 키가 아니고, -- firstDttm 은 '이력 포함 전체 최소값' 이어야 한다(바깥 WHERE 에 그대로 둔다). WHERE ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR s0.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ( ( ISNULL(#{shpoutDtFrom,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') <> '' AND ISNULL(#{shpoutDtTo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') <> '' AND s0.SHPOUT_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{shpoutDtFrom,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') AND REPLACE(#{shpoutDtTo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') ) OR ( ISNULL(#{shpoutDtFrom,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' AND ISNULL(#{shpoutDtTo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' AND ISNULL(#{shpoutDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') <> '' AND s0.SHPOUT_DT = REPLACE(#{shpoutDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') ) OR ( ISNULL(#{shpoutDtFrom,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' AND ISNULL(#{shpoutDtTo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' AND ISNULL(#{shpoutDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' ) ) ) t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.PROD_CD, p.SALE_PRICE, p.COMP_CD FROM TBL_PROD_MST p WHERE p.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND p.PROD_SEQ = (SELECT MAX(p2.PROD_SEQ) FROM TBL_PROD_MST p2 WHERE p2.PROD_CD = p.PROD_CD AND p2.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND p2.COMP_CD = p.COMP_CD) ) pm ON pm.PROD_CD = t.PROD_CD AND pm.COMP_CD = t.COMP_CD OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 h.SALE_PRICE FROM TBL_PROD_SALEPRICE_HST h WHERE h.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND h.PROD_CD = t.PROD_CD AND h.APPLY_DT <= t.DLV_DT AND h.COMP_CD = t.COMP_CD AND h.VENDOR_CD IS NULL -- 공통가만 (마감과 동일 — 판매처 전용가는 섞지 않는다) ORDER BY h.APPLY_DT DESC, h.SALEPRICE_SEQ DESC ) sh CROSS APPLY ( SELECT ISNULL(sh.SALE_PRICE, ISNULL(pm.SALE_PRICE,0)) AS saleUnit, CASE WHEN sh.SALE_PRICE IS NOT NULL THEN '이력' ELSE '마스터' END AS saleSrc ) u WHERE t.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR t.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ( ( ISNULL(#{shpoutDtFrom,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') <> '' AND ISNULL(#{shpoutDtTo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') <> '' AND t.SHPOUT_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{shpoutDtFrom,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') AND REPLACE(#{shpoutDtTo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') ) OR ( ISNULL(#{shpoutDtFrom,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' AND ISNULL(#{shpoutDtTo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' AND ISNULL(#{shpoutDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') <> '' AND t.SHPOUT_DT = REPLACE(#{shpoutDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') ) OR ( ISNULL(#{shpoutDtFrom,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' AND ISNULL(#{shpoutDtTo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' AND ISNULL(#{shpoutDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' ) ) ORDER BY t.SHPOUT_DT DESC, t.BIZ_NM, t.ITEM_NM, t.ROW_NO

-- ★속도(2026-07-31): 행마다 돌던 상관 서브쿼리 2개(firstDttm MIN / 직전차수 MAX(JOB_SEQ))를 -- 윈도우 함수로 교체 — selectShipoutMst 의 firstDttm 최적화(944ms→73ms, 2026-07-25)와 같은 수법. -- 운영 실측 이 쿼리 단독 2.2s 가 대시보드 최초 진입의 최장 병목이었다. -- · firstDttm 파티션은 종전 서브쿼리와 동일(ACTION_YN 무관 전체 최소값) → 가장 안쪽에서 계산 -- · maxSeq(직전차수)는 ACTION_YN='N' 필터 후 계산해야 종전과 동일(이력 중 최신 차수) SELECT t.SHPOUT_DT AS shpoutDt, t.DLV_DT AS dlvDt, t.JOB_SEQ AS jobSeq, t.ROW_NO AS rowNo, t.SRC_FILE AS srcFile, CONVERT(varchar(19), t.UPLOAD_DTTM, 120) AS uploadDttm, t.firstDttm, t.DC_CD AS dcCd, t.DC_NM AS dcNm, t.VENDOR_CD AS vendorCd, t.VENDOR_NM AS vendorNm, t.ITEM_CD AS itemCd, t.ITEM_NM AS itemNm, t.BIZ_CD AS bizCd, t.BIZ_NM AS bizNm, t.BOX_QTY AS boxQty, t.LABEL_QTY AS labelQty, t.UNPAID_LABEL_QTY AS unpaidLabelQty, t.INWH AS inwh, t.ZONE AS zone, t.BUS_NO AS busNo, t.RT_SEQ AS rtSeq, t.CUR_QTY AS curQty, t.DLV_GB AS dlvGb, t.REMARK AS remark, t.PROD_KIND AS prodKind, t.TEMP_GB AS tempGb, t.ORD_GB AS ordGb, t.UNIT AS unit, t.ORD_NO AS ordNo, t.ORD_ITEM_NO AS ordItemNo, t.JUMUN_NO AS jumunNo, t.JUMUN_ITEM_NO AS jumunItemNo FROM ( SELECT s.*, MAX(s.JOB_SEQ) OVER (PARTITION BY s.COMP_CD, s.SHPOUT_DT, s.DLV_DT, ISNULL(s.DC_CD,'')) AS maxSeq FROM ( SELECT s0.*, CONVERT(varchar(19), MIN(s0.UPLOAD_DTTM) OVER (PARTITION BY s0.COMP_CD, s0.SHPOUT_DT, ISNULL(s0.DC_CD,''), ISNULL(s0.BIZ_CD,''), ISNULL(s0.ITEM_CD,'')), 120) AS firstDttm FROM TBL_SHIPOUT_MST s0 -- ★★속도 (2026-08-07 실측) — 이 안쪽 WHERE 가 핵심이다. -- 종전에는 여기가 `FROM TBL_SHIPOUT_MST s0` 뿐이라, 하루치 257건을 보려고 -- **49,933행 전체**에 윈도우 함수를 돌린 뒤 바깥에서 날짜로 걸렀다(810ms). -- ★안전한 이유 : PARTITION BY 에 SHPOUT_DT·COMP_CD 가 이미 들어 있다. -- 다른 날짜/회사 행은 애초에 다른 파티션이라 결과에 영향을 줄 수 없으므로, -- 날짜·회사 조건을 안쪽으로 옮겨도 firstDttm 값이 100% 같다. -- ★ACTION_YN 은 절대 안쪽으로 옮기지 말 것 — 파티션 키가 아니고, -- firstDttm 은 '이력 포함 전체 최소값' 이어야 한다(바깥 WHERE 에 그대로 둔다). WHERE s0.SHPOUT_DT = REPLACE(ISNULL(#{shpoutDt},''),'-','') AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR s0.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ) s WHERE s.SHPOUT_DT = REPLACE(ISNULL(#{shpoutDt},''),'-','') AND s.ACTION_YN = 'N' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR s.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ) t WHERE t.JOB_SEQ = t.maxSeq ORDER BY t.BIZ_NM, t.ITEM_NM, t.ROW_NO

SELECT l.LEDGER_SEQ AS ledgerSeq, l.PROD_SEQ AS prodSeq, l.PROD_CD AS prodCd, l.TRX_DT AS trxDt, l.IO_GB AS ioGb, l.QTY AS qty, l.UNIT_PRICE AS unitPrice, l.AMT AS amt, l.BAL_QTY AS balQty, l.VENDOR_CD AS vendorCd, /* 거래처명 — 코드만 보이면 어디로 나간 건지 읽을 수 없다(2026-08-01 요청). 판매전표(SALE)의 거래처는 삼성웰스토리 지점 같은 '사업장' 이라 이 이름이 곧 사업장 명칭이 된다. */ (SELECT MAX(v.VENDOR_NM) FROM TBL_VENDOR_MST v WHERE v.VENDOR_CD = l.VENDOR_CD AND v.ACTION_YN='Y' AND v.COMP_CD = l.COMP_CD) AS vendorNm, /* 사업장: SHIPOUT 자동연동 행은 BIZ_CD 가 NULL → 출고원본(TBL_SHIPOUT_MST)에서 같은 품목·출고일자의 사업장명을 모아 표시 (여러 곳이면 콤마 구분) */ CASE WHEN l.REF_GB = 'SHIPOUT' THEN ISNULL(STUFF((SELECT DISTINCT ', ' + s.BIZ_NM FROM TBL_SHIPOUT_MST s WHERE s.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND s.PROD_CD = l.PROD_CD AND s.COMP_CD = l.COMP_CD AND s.SHPOUT_DT = l.REF_NO AND ISNULL(s.BIZ_NM,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(s.CUR_QTY,0) > 0 FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.','NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, ''), l.BIZ_CD) ELSE l.BIZ_CD END AS bizCd, /* ★대체출고 내역 (2026-08-07 요청) 재고는 '대표코드(주코드)' 하나로 떨어지지만, 실제로 나간 건 거래처 매칭코드다. 예) 대표 9904013222 로 20개가 빠졌는데 실제는 1000736040 18개 + 1000742589 2개. 원장에는 주코드만 남아(EXT_CD 칸이 없다) 어느 코드로 나갔는지 알 수 없어 출고원본(TBL_SHIPOUT_MST)에서 되짚는다. 그쪽은 원본 매칭코드(ITEM_CD)와 해석된 주코드(PROD_CD)를 둘 다 갖고 있다 — resolveShipoutProd* 가 PROD_CD 를 채운다. · 대체가 하나도 없는 날(ITEM_CD = PROD_CD)은 빈 값 → 평소 화면이 지저분해지지 않는다. · 대체가 있는 날은 주코드분까지 함께 내려 준다. 수량 합이 원장 수량과 맞아야 하므로. (실측 20260121 : 원장 20 = 1000736040(18) + 1000742589(2) — 2026-08-07 확인)
★형식 : 코드(수량)~사업장1, 사업장2 ← 이것이 한 덩이. 덩이끼리는 '|' 로 잇는다. 예) 1000455367(7)~노머시버거, 워치타워(매점)|1000725262(1)~아티안국_홀 화면은 이 덩이를 대표코드 아래 '하위 행' 으로 펼쳐, 코드마다 수량·사업장을 대표 줄과 같은 칸에 세운다(2026-08-07 요청). 그래서 사업장까지 코드별로 나눠 담는다. 구분자는 '|' 와 '~' — 사업장명에는 콤마·괄호가 들어가지만 이 둘은 안 쓰인다. */ CASE WHEN l.REF_GB = 'SHIPOUT' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TBL_SHIPOUT_MST s2 WHERE s2.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND s2.PROD_CD = l.PROD_CD AND s2.COMP_CD = l.COMP_CD AND s2.SHPOUT_DT = l.REF_NO AND ISNULL(s2.CUR_QTY,0) > 0 AND ISNULL(s2.ITEM_CD,'') <> ISNULL(s2.PROD_CD,'')) THEN STUFF((SELECT '|' + x.ITEM_CD + '(' + CAST(CAST(x.q AS INT) AS VARCHAR(12)) + ')~' + ISNULL(x.bizs,'') FROM (SELECT s.ITEM_CD, SUM(ISNULL(s.CUR_QTY,0)) AS q, /* 그 코드로 나간 사업장 — 대표 줄 사업장 칸과 같은 규칙(중복 제거·콤마) */ STUFF((SELECT DISTINCT ', ' + s3.BIZ_NM FROM TBL_SHIPOUT_MST s3 WHERE s3.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND s3.PROD_CD = l.PROD_CD AND s3.COMP_CD = l.COMP_CD AND s3.SHPOUT_DT = l.REF_NO AND s3.ITEM_CD = s.ITEM_CD AND ISNULL(s3.CUR_QTY,0) > 0 AND ISNULL(s3.BIZ_NM,'') <> '' FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.','NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, '') AS bizs FROM TBL_SHIPOUT_MST s WHERE s.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND s.PROD_CD = l.PROD_CD AND s.COMP_CD = l.COMP_CD AND s.SHPOUT_DT = l.REF_NO AND ISNULL(s.CUR_QTY,0) > 0 GROUP BY s.ITEM_CD) x ORDER BY x.q DESC FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.','NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '') ELSE '' END AS extCds, l.REF_GB AS refGb, l.REF_NO AS refNo, l.REMARK AS remark, l.REG_DTTM AS regDttm, l.REG_USER AS regUser FROM TBL_STOCK_LEDGER l WHERE l.PROD_SEQ = #{prodSeq} AND l.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR l.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ORDER BY l.TRX_DT DESC, l.LEDGER_SEQ DESC

SELECT l.PROD_SEQ AS prodSeq, l.PROD_CD AS prodCd, ISNULL(p.PROD_NM,'') AS prodNm, SUM(CASE WHEN l.IO_GB IN ('I','R','A') THEN l.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS inQty, SUM(CASE WHEN l.IO_GB = 'O' THEN l.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS outQty, SUM(CASE WHEN l.IO_GB IN ('I','R','A') THEN l.QTY WHEN l.IO_GB='O' THEN -l.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS curQty, MAX(m.AVG_IN_PRICE) AS avgInPrice, MAX(m.LAST_INPRICE) AS lastInprice, MAX(m.LAST_SALEPRICE) AS lastSaleprice, SUM(CASE WHEN l.IO_GB IN ('I','R','A') THEN l.QTY WHEN l.IO_GB='O' THEN -l.QTY ELSE 0 END) * ISNULL(MAX(m.AVG_IN_PRICE),0) AS stockAmt, MAX(CASE WHEN l.IO_GB='I' THEN l.TRX_DT END) AS lastInDt, MAX(CASE WHEN l.IO_GB='O' THEN l.TRX_DT END) AS lastOutDt, /* ★매칭코드별 출고수량 (2026-08-07 요청) ①표가 품목코드 밑에 매칭코드를 ↳ 로 보여주는데, ②수불 내역은 그 줄에 수량까지 달려 있어 두 표가 달라 보였다. 여기서도 코드마다 출고수량을 준다. · 형식 : 코드:수량|코드:수량 (화면이 쪼개 ↳ 줄에 붙인다) · ★출고만 나뉜다. 입고는 매입전표가 '주코드'로 들어오므로 코드별로 가를 수 없다. 그래서 ↳ 줄에는 출고수량만 붙고, 입고·현재고는 대표 줄의 합산만 있다. · 기준일(asOfDt)을 주면 그날까지만 — 위 원장 집계와 같은 기간이어야 합이 맞는다. (실측 9904013222 : 2,999 + 39 = 3,038 = 대표 줄 출고합 — 2026-08-07 확인) */ /* ★이 SELECT 는 GROUP BY 아래에 있다 — 서브쿼리 안에서 l.COMP_CD 를 그냥 쓰면 "집계 함수나 GROUP BY 절에 없다" 로 깨진다(2026-08-07 실제로 겪음). GROUP BY 키인 l.PROD_CD 는 그대로 쓸 수 있고, COMP_CD 는 MAX() 로 감싼다. 한 품목이 여러 회사에 걸치지 않으므로 MAX 여도 값은 하나다. */ STUFF((SELECT '|' + x.ITEM_CD + ':' + CAST(CAST(x.q AS INT) AS VARCHAR(12)) FROM (SELECT s2.ITEM_CD, SUM(ISNULL(s2.CUR_QTY,0)) AS q FROM TBL_SHIPOUT_MST s2 WHERE s2.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND s2.COMP_CD = MAX(l.COMP_CD) AND s2.PROD_CD = l.PROD_CD AND ISNULL(s2.CUR_QTY,0) > 0 AND ( ISNULL(#{asOfDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR s2.SHPOUT_DT <= REPLACE(#{asOfDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') ) GROUP BY s2.ITEM_CD) x ORDER BY x.q DESC FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.','NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '') AS extQtys FROM TBL_STOCK_LEDGER l LEFT JOIN TBL_STOCK_MST m ON m.PROD_SEQ = l.PROD_SEQ AND m.COMP_CD = l.COMP_CD LEFT JOIN TBL_PROD_MST p ON p.PROD_SEQ = (SELECT MAX(p2.PROD_SEQ) FROM TBL_PROD_MST p2 WHERE p2.PROD_CD = l.PROD_CD AND p2.ACTION_YN='Y' AND p2.COMP_CD = l.COMP_CD) WHERE l.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR l.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
AND l.TRX_DT <= REPLACE(#{asOfDt},'-','')
AND ( l.PROD_CD LIKE '%' + #{findData} + '%' OR ISNULL(p.PROD_NM,'') LIKE '%' + #{findData} + '%' )

UNION 의 첫 가지가 컬럼명을 정하므로 파생표 컬럼이 dt 가 아니라 ym 이 되어 바깥의 SELECT x.dt / GROUP BY x.dt 가 'Invalid column name dt' 로 죽었다(원장이 안 떴음). 게다가 이 가지만 월(6자리), 나머지는 일자(8자리)라 섞여 있었다. 일자로 통일한다. */ SELECT ISNULL(NULLIF(s.DLV_DT,''), s.OUT_DT) AS dt, ISNULL(s.SALE_AMT,0) AS saleAmt, 0 AS dcAmt, 0 AS rcvAmt, 0 AS purchAmt, 0 AS payAmt, 0 AS discAmt FROM TBL_SALES_MST s WHERE s.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR s.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ISNULL(NULLIF(s.DLV_DT,''), s.OUT_DT) IS NOT NULL AND s.DC_CD = ( SELECT MAX(v.DC_CD) FROM TBL_VENDOR_MST v WHERE v.VENDOR_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR v.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND v.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ISNULL(v.DC_CD,'') <> '' ) UNION ALL -- 판매전표(정산서 밖에서 직접 판 건) — 거래처코드로 바로 붙는다 SELECT ISNULL(NULLIF(t2.DLV_DT,''), t2.SALE_DT) AS dt, ISNULL(t2.TOT_AMT,0) AS saleAmt, ISNULL(t2.DC_AMT,0) AS dcAmt, ISNULL(t2.PAY_AMT,0) AS rcvAmt, 0 AS purchAmt, 0 AS payAmt, 0 AS discAmt FROM TBL_SALES_TRX_MST t2 WHERE t2.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND t2.CUST_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR t2.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) UNION ALL SELECT m.PURCH_DT AS dt, 0 AS saleAmt, 0 AS dcAmt, 0 AS rcvAmt, ISNULL(m.TOT_AMT,0) AS purchAmt, ISNULL(m.PAY_AMT,0) AS payAmt, ISNULL(m.DC_AMT,0) AS discAmt FROM TBL_PURCHASE_MST m WHERE m.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND m.VENDOR_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) UNION ALL SELECT t.TRX_DT, 0, ISNULL(t.SALE_DC_AMT,0), CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB='RCV' THEN ISNULL(t.AMT,0) ELSE 0 END, 0, CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB='PAY' THEN ISNULL(t.AMT,0) ELSE 0 END, ISNULL(t.DC_AMT,0) FROM TBL_SETTLE_TRX t WHERE t.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND t.CUST_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR t.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ) x GROUP BY x.dt ORDER BY x.dt

SELECT g.custCd AS custCd, ISNULL(v.VENDOR_NM, g.custNm) AS custNm, ISNULL(v.VENDOR_GB,'') AS vendorGb, ISNULL(v.MGR_NM,'') AS mgrNm, ISNULL(v.TEL,'') AS tel, ISNULL(v.DC_CD,'') AS dcCd, -- 출고장코드(E100~E700). 화면에서 대시보드와 같은 묶음(오산센터 등)을 만든다 g.ym AS ym, g.saleAmt AS saleAmt, -- 매출(정산서+판매전표) g.saleDcAmt AS saleDcAmt, -- 매출할인 g.rcvAmt AS rcvAmt, -- 수금 g.purchAmt AS purchAmt, -- 매입 g.purchDcAmt AS purchDcAmt, -- 매입할인 g.payAmt AS payAmt, -- 지급 g.lastDt AS lastDt -- 그 달의 마지막 거래일 FROM ( SELECT x.custCd AS custCd, MAX(x.custNm) AS custNm, x.ym AS ym, SUM(x.saleAmt) AS saleAmt, SUM(x.saleDcAmt) AS saleDcAmt, SUM(x.rcvAmt) AS rcvAmt, SUM(x.purchAmt) AS purchAmt, SUM(x.purchDcAmt) AS purchDcAmt, SUM(x.payAmt) AS payAmt, MAX(x.dt) AS lastDt FROM ( -- ① 정산서 매출 → 출고장코드(DC_CD)로 거래처에 붙인다 SELECT vm.VENDOR_CD AS custCd, vm.VENDOR_NM AS custNm, LEFT(ISNULL(NULLIF(s.DLV_DT,''), s.OUT_DT),6) AS ym, ISNULL(NULLIF(s.DLV_DT,''), s.OUT_DT) AS dt, ISNULL(s.SALE_AMT,0) AS saleAmt, 0 AS saleDcAmt, 0 AS rcvAmt, 0 AS purchAmt, 0 AS purchDcAmt, 0 AS payAmt FROM TBL_SALES_MST s CROSS APPLY ( SELECT CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_CD,'') <> '' THEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.DC_CD))) WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%용인%' THEN 'E100' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%왜관%' THEN 'E200' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%김해%' THEN 'E300' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%광주%' THEN 'E400' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%평택%' THEN 'E500' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%제주%' THEN 'E600' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%오산%' THEN 'E700' ELSE '' END AS dcKey ) dk -- 출고장 1곳에 거래처가 둘 이상 잡히면 매출이 두 배가 된다 → DC_CD 로 미리 1행으로 접는다 JOIN ( SELECT DC_CD, MIN(VENDOR_CD) AS VENDOR_CD, MIN(VENDOR_NM) AS VENDOR_NM FROM TBL_VENDOR_MST WHERE ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ISNULL(DC_CD,'') <> '' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) GROUP BY DC_CD ) vm ON vm.DC_CD = dk.dcKey WHERE s.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR s.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ISNULL(NULLIF(s.DLV_DT,''), s.OUT_DT) IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL -- ② 판매전표 — 매출 + 전표에 적힌 즉시수금 SELECT t2.CUST_CD, t2.CUST_NM, LEFT(ISNULL(NULLIF(t2.DLV_DT,''), t2.SALE_DT),6), ISNULL(NULLIF(t2.DLV_DT,''), t2.SALE_DT), ISNULL(t2.TOT_AMT,0), ISNULL(t2.DC_AMT,0), ISNULL(t2.PAY_AMT,0), 0, 0, 0 FROM TBL_SALES_TRX_MST t2 WHERE t2.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR t2.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
UNION ALL -- ③ 매입전표 — 매입 + 전표에 적힌 즉시지급 SELECT m.VENDOR_CD, m.VENDOR_NM, LEFT(m.PURCH_DT,6), m.PURCH_DT, 0, 0, 0, ISNULL(m.TOT_AMT,0), ISNULL(m.DC_AMT,0), ISNULL(m.PAY_AMT,0) FROM TBL_PURCHASE_MST m WHERE m.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
UNION ALL -- ④ 수금/지급 전표 — 같은 표에 TRX_GB 로 갈린다 SELECT t.CUST_CD, t.CUST_NM, LEFT(t.TRX_DT,6), t.TRX_DT, 0, CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB = 'RCV' THEN ISNULL(t.SALE_DC_AMT,0) ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB = 'RCV' THEN ISNULL(t.AMT,0) ELSE 0 END, 0, CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB = 'PAY' THEN ISNULL(t.DC_AMT,0) ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB = 'PAY' THEN ISNULL(t.AMT,0) ELSE 0 END FROM TBL_SETTLE_TRX t WHERE t.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR t.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ) x WHERE ISNULL(x.custCd,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(x.ym,'') <> '' GROUP BY x.custCd, x.ym ) g LEFT JOIN TBL_VENDOR_MST v ON v.VENDOR_CD = g.custCd AND v.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR v.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ORDER BY g.custCd, g.ym

SELECT z.gb AS gb, z.gbNm AS gbNm, z.dt AS dt, z.docNo AS docNo, z.place AS place, z.itemCd AS itemCd, z.itemNm AS itemNm, z.qty AS qty, z.price AS price, z.amt AS amt, z.remark AS remark, z.extCd AS extCd FROM ( -- ① 출고(정산서) — 거래처마스터 DC_CD 로 이어진다 SELECT 'SALE' AS gb, N'출고(정산서)' AS gbNm, ISNULL(NULLIF(s.DLV_DT,''), s.OUT_DT) AS dt, LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(s.ORD_NO,''))) + CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.ORD_ITEM_NO,'') <> '' THEN '-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(s.ORD_ITEM_NO)) ELSE '' END AS docNo, ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') AS place, ISNULL(s.ITEM_CD,'') AS itemCd, ISNULL(s.ITEM_NM,'') AS itemNm, ISNULL(s.OUT_QTY,0) AS qty, ISNULL(s.SALE_PRICE,0) AS price, ISNULL(s.SALE_AMT,0) AS amt, ISNULL(s.UNIT,'') AS remark, '' AS extCd FROM TBL_SALES_MST s CROSS APPLY ( SELECT CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_CD,'') <> '' THEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.DC_CD))) WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%용인%' THEN 'E100' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%왜관%' THEN 'E200' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%김해%' THEN 'E300' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%광주%' THEN 'E400' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%평택%' THEN 'E500' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%제주%' THEN 'E600' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%오산%' THEN 'E700' ELSE '' END AS dcKey ) dk WHERE s.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR s.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ISNULL(NULLIF(s.DLV_DT,''), s.OUT_DT) = REPLACE(ISNULL(#{trxDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},''),'-','') AND dk.dcKey <> '' AND dk.dcKey IN ( SELECT DC_CD FROM TBL_VENDOR_MST WHERE ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ISNULL(DC_CD,'') <> '' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) GROUP BY DC_CD HAVING MIN(VENDOR_CD) = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
UNION ALL -- ①-2 직접 판 판매전표 명세 (출고내역 탭에 함께 — 잔액의 매출이 정산서 + 이 전표라서) SELECT 'STRX', N'판매전표', ISNULL(NULLIF(t2.DLV_DT,''), t2.SALE_DT), ISNULL(t2.SALE_DT,'') + '-' + ISNULL(t2.SALE_NO,''), ISNULL(t2.WH_NM,''), ISNULL(d2.PROD_CD,''), ISNULL(d2.PROD_NM, N'(명세 없음)'), ISNULL(d2.QTY,0), ISNULL(d2.UNIT_PRICE,0), ISNULL(d2.TOT_AMT, t2.TOT_AMT), ISNULL(d2.REMARK, ISNULL(t2.REMARK,'')), ISNULL(d2.EXT_CD,'') FROM TBL_SALES_TRX_MST t2 LEFT JOIN TBL_SALES_TRX_DTL d2 ON d2.SALE_SEQ = t2.SALE_SEQ AND d2.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND d2.COMP_CD = t2.COMP_CD WHERE t2.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND t2.CUST_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR t2.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ISNULL(NULLIF(t2.DLV_DT,''), t2.SALE_DT) = REPLACE(ISNULL(#{trxDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},''),'-','')
UNION ALL -- ② 매입내역 — 매입전표 명세 SELECT 'PURCH', N'매입전표', m.PURCH_DT, ISNULL(m.PURCH_DT,'') + '-' + ISNULL(m.PURCH_NO,''), ISNULL(m.WH_NM,''), ISNULL(d.PROD_CD,''), ISNULL(d.PROD_NM, N'(명세 없음)'), ISNULL(d.QTY,0), ISNULL(d.UNIT_PRICE,0), ISNULL(d.TOT_AMT, m.TOT_AMT), ISNULL(d.REMARK, ISNULL(m.REMARK,'')), '' FROM TBL_PURCHASE_MST m LEFT JOIN TBL_PURCHASE_DTL d ON d.PURCH_SEQ = m.PURCH_SEQ AND d.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND d.COMP_CD = m.COMP_CD WHERE m.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND m.VENDOR_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND m.PURCH_DT = REPLACE(ISNULL(#{trxDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},''),'-','')
UNION ALL -- ③④ 입금(수금)·출금(지급) 전표 — 같은 표에서 TRX_GB 로 갈린다 SELECT CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB = 'RCV' THEN 'RCV' ELSE 'PAY' END, CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB = 'RCV' THEN N'입금(수금)' ELSE N'출금(지급)' END, t.TRX_DT, ISNULL(t.TRX_DT,'') + '-' + ISNULL(t.TRX_NO,''), ISNULL(t.ACCT_NM, ISNULL(t.PAY_GB,'')), '', ISNULL(t.PAY_GB, N'(구분 없음)'), 0, 0, ISNULL(t.AMT,0), ISNULL(t.REMARK,''), '' FROM TBL_SETTLE_TRX t WHERE t.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND t.CUST_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR t.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND t.TRX_DT = REPLACE(ISNULL(#{trxDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},''),'-','') ) z ORDER BY CASE z.gb WHEN 'SALE' THEN 1 WHEN 'STRX' THEN 2 WHEN 'PURCH' THEN 3 WHEN 'RCV' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, z.docNo, z.itemCd

;WITH SRC AS ( -- ① 정산서 매출 → 출고장코드(DC_CD)로 거래처에 붙인다 (selectCustBalance 와 동일 규칙) SELECT vm.VENDOR_CD AS custCd, vm.VENDOR_NM AS custNm, ISNULL(NULLIF(s.DLV_DT,''), s.OUT_DT) AS dt, ISNULL(s.SALE_AMT,0) AS saleAmt, 0 AS saleDcAmt, 0 AS rcvAmt, 0 AS purchAmt, 0 AS purchDcAmt, 0 AS payAmt FROM TBL_SALES_MST s CROSS APPLY ( SELECT CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_CD,'') <> '' THEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.DC_CD))) WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%용인%' THEN 'E100' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%왜관%' THEN 'E200' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%김해%' THEN 'E300' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%광주%' THEN 'E400' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%평택%' THEN 'E500' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%제주%' THEN 'E600' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%오산%' THEN 'E700' ELSE '' END AS dcKey ) dk JOIN ( SELECT DC_CD, MIN(VENDOR_CD) AS VENDOR_CD, MIN(VENDOR_NM) AS VENDOR_NM FROM TBL_VENDOR_MST WHERE ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ISNULL(DC_CD,'') <> '' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) GROUP BY DC_CD ) vm ON vm.DC_CD = dk.dcKey WHERE s.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR s.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ISNULL(NULLIF(s.DLV_DT,''), s.OUT_DT) IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL -- ② 판매전표 SELECT t2.CUST_CD, t2.CUST_NM, ISNULL(NULLIF(t2.DLV_DT,''), t2.SALE_DT), ISNULL(t2.TOT_AMT,0), ISNULL(t2.DC_AMT,0), ISNULL(t2.PAY_AMT,0), 0, 0, 0 FROM TBL_SALES_TRX_MST t2 WHERE t2.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR t2.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
UNION ALL -- ③ 매입전표 SELECT m.VENDOR_CD, m.VENDOR_NM, m.PURCH_DT, 0, 0, 0, ISNULL(m.TOT_AMT,0), ISNULL(m.DC_AMT,0), ISNULL(m.PAY_AMT,0) FROM TBL_PURCHASE_MST m WHERE m.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
UNION ALL -- ④ 수금/지급 전표 SELECT t.CUST_CD, t.CUST_NM, t.TRX_DT, 0, CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB = 'RCV' THEN ISNULL(t.SALE_DC_AMT,0) ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB = 'RCV' THEN ISNULL(t.AMT,0) ELSE 0 END, 0, CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB = 'PAY' THEN ISNULL(t.DC_AMT,0) ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN t.TRX_GB = 'PAY' THEN ISNULL(t.AMT,0) ELSE 0 END FROM TBL_SETTLE_TRX t WHERE t.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR t.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ) SELECT g.dt AS dt, g.custCd AS custCd, ISNULL(v.VENDOR_NM, g.custNm) AS custNm, ISNULL(v.VENDOR_GB,'') AS vendorGb, ISNULL(v.DC_CD,'') AS dcCd, g.saleAmt AS saleAmt, g.saleDcAmt AS saleDcAmt, g.rcvAmt AS rcvAmt, g.purchAmt AS purchAmt, g.purchDcAmt AS purchDcAmt, g.payAmt AS payAmt FROM ( -- ⓐ 조회 기간에 그날 생긴 것 SELECT x.dt AS dt, x.custCd AS custCd, MAX(x.custNm) AS custNm, SUM(x.saleAmt) AS saleAmt, SUM(x.saleDcAmt) AS saleDcAmt, SUM(x.rcvAmt) AS rcvAmt, SUM(x.purchAmt) AS purchAmt, SUM(x.purchDcAmt) AS purchDcAmt, SUM(x.payAmt) AS payAmt FROM SRC x WHERE ISNULL(x.custCd,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(x.dt,'') <> '' AND x.dt >= REPLACE(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') AND x.dt <= REPLACE(#{toDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') GROUP BY x.dt, x.custCd
UNION ALL -- ⓑ 그 이전까지의 누계 = 전일잔액. dt 를 '00000000' 로 세워 화면이 구분한다 SELECT '00000000' AS dt, x.custCd, MAX(x.custNm), SUM(x.saleAmt), SUM(x.saleDcAmt), SUM(x.rcvAmt), SUM(x.purchAmt), SUM(x.purchDcAmt), SUM(x.payAmt) FROM SRC x WHERE ISNULL(x.custCd,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(x.dt,'') <> '' AND x.dt < REPLACE(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') GROUP BY x.custCd ) g LEFT JOIN TBL_VENDOR_MST v ON v.VENDOR_CD = g.custCd AND v.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR v.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ORDER BY g.dt, g.custCd

SELECT m.SALE_SEQ AS saleSeq, m.SALE_DT AS saleDt, m.SALE_NO AS saleNo, m.DLV_DT AS dlvDt, m.CUST_CD AS custCd, m.CUST_NM AS custNm, m.MGR_CD AS mgrCd, m.MGR_NM AS mgrNm, m.WH_CD AS whCd, m.WH_NM AS whNm, m.TOT_BOX_QTY AS totBoxQty, m.TOT_EA_QTY AS totEaQty, m.TOT_QTY AS totQty, m.SUPPLY_AMT AS supplyAmt, m.VAT_AMT AS vatAmt, m.TOT_AMT AS totAmt, m.DC_AMT AS dcAmt, m.PAY_GB AS payGb, m.PAY_AMT AS payAmt, m.TAX_GB AS taxGb, m.REMARK AS remark, m.REG_DTTM AS regDttm, m.REG_USER AS regUser, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_SALES_TRX_DTL d WHERE d.SALE_SEQ = m.SALE_SEQ AND d.ACTION_YN='Y' AND d.COMP_CD = m.COMP_CD) AS prodCnt FROM TBL_SALES_TRX_MST m WHERE m.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ( ISNULL(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.SALE_DT >= REPLACE(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') ) AND ( ISNULL(#{toDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.SALE_DT <= REPLACE(#{toDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') ) AND ( ISNULL(#{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.CUST_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ( ISNULL(#{mgrCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.MGR_CD = #{mgrCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ( ISNULL(#{findData,jdbcType=NVARCHAR},'') = '' OR ISNULL(m.CUST_NM,'') LIKE '%' + #{findData,jdbcType=NVARCHAR} + '%' ) ORDER BY m.SALE_DT DESC, m.SALE_NO DESC, m.SALE_SEQ DESC

SELECT ISNULL(NULLIF(m.DLV_DT,''), m.SALE_DT) AS dlvDt, m.SALE_DT AS outDt, '직접판매(전표)' AS dcNm, '' AS dcCd, m.CUST_CD AS custCd, m.CUST_NM AS custNm, m.SALE_NO AS ordNo, CAST(d.ROW_NO AS VARCHAR(10)) AS ordItemNo, d.PROD_CD AS itemCd, d.PROD_NM AS itemNm, d.SPEC AS spec, CASE WHEN d.TRX_GB = '반품' THEN -ISNULL(d.QTY,0) ELSE ISNULL(d.QTY,0) END AS outQty, CASE WHEN d.TRX_GB = '반품' THEN -ISNULL(d.QTY,0) ELSE ISNULL(d.QTY,0) END AS settleQty, CASE WHEN d.TRX_GB = '반품' THEN -ISNULL(d.TOT_AMT,0) ELSE ISNULL(d.TOT_AMT,0) END AS saleAmt, ISNULL(d.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS salePrice, 'Y' AS trxYn, d.TRX_GB AS trxGb FROM TBL_SALES_TRX_DTL d JOIN TBL_SALES_TRX_MST m ON m.SALE_SEQ = d.SALE_SEQ AND m.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND m.COMP_CD = d.COMP_CD WHERE d.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR d.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ( ISNULL(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR ISNULL(NULLIF(m.DLV_DT,''), m.SALE_DT) >= REPLACE(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') ) AND ( ISNULL(#{toDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR ISNULL(NULLIF(m.DLV_DT,''), m.SALE_DT) <= REPLACE(#{toDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') ) AND ( ISNULL(#{findData,jdbcType=NVARCHAR},'') = '' OR ISNULL(d.PROD_CD,'') LIKE '%' + #{findData,jdbcType=NVARCHAR} + '%' OR ISNULL(d.PROD_NM,'') LIKE '%' + #{findData,jdbcType=NVARCHAR} + '%' ) ORDER BY ISNULL(NULLIF(m.DLV_DT,''), m.SALE_DT), m.SALE_NO, d.ROW_NO

SELECT m.SALE_DT AS spec, -- 거래일자 (화면 표시용으로 spec 칸 재사용) m.CUST_NM AS prodNm, -- 거래처 d.UNIT_PRICE AS unitPrice, d.BOX_QTY AS boxQty, d.EA_QTY AS eaQty, d.QTY AS qty, d.AMT AS amt, d.EVENT_YN AS eventYn, d.TRX_GB AS trxGb FROM TBL_SALES_TRX_DTL d JOIN TBL_SALES_TRX_MST m ON m.SALE_SEQ = d.SALE_SEQ AND m.ACTION_YN='Y' AND m.COMP_CD = d.COMP_CD WHERE d.ACTION_YN='Y' AND d.PROD_CD = #{prodCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR d.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ( ISNULL(#{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.CUST_CD = #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND m.SALE_DT >= CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(YEAR,-3,GETDATE()), 112) -- 최대 3년 ORDER BY m.SALE_DT DESC, m.SALE_NO DESC

SELECT x.prodCd AS prodCd, ISNULL(p.PROD_NM, x.prodNm) AS prodNm, ISNULL(p.SPEC, '') AS spec, ISNULL(p.MAKER_NM, '') AS makerNm, ISNULL(p.PACK_QTY, 1) AS packQty, ISNULL(p.TAX_GB, N'과세') AS taxGb, p.PROD_SEQ AS prodSeq, x.unitPrice AS unitPrice, x.qty AS qty, x.lastDt AS lastDt, x.cnt AS cnt, x.srcGb AS srcGb, ISNULL(st.curQty, 0) AS curQty FROM ( SELECT u.prodCd, u.prodNm, u.unitPrice, u.qty, u.srcGb, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.prodCd ORDER BY u.dt DESC, u.unitPrice DESC) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY u.prodCd) AS cnt, MAX(u.dt) OVER (PARTITION BY u.prodCd) AS lastDt FROM ( /* ① 판매전표 — 직접 판 건 */ SELECT d.PROD_CD AS prodCd, d.PROD_NM AS prodNm, ISNULL(NULLIF(m.DLV_DT,''), m.SALE_DT) AS dt, ISNULL(d.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS unitPrice, ISNULL(d.QTY,0) AS qty, N'전표' AS srcGb FROM TBL_SALES_TRX_DTL d JOIN TBL_SALES_TRX_MST m ON m.SALE_SEQ = d.SALE_SEQ AND m.ACTION_YN='Y' AND m.COMP_CD = d.COMP_CD WHERE d.ACTION_YN='Y' AND ISNULL(d.PROD_CD,'') <> '' AND m.CUST_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR d.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ( ISNULL(#{srcFilter,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') IN ('','TRX') ) AND ( ISNULL(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR ISNULL(NULLIF(m.DLV_DT,''), m.SALE_DT) >= REPLACE(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') ) UNION ALL /* ② 정산서 — 출고장이 준 실제 납품분. 거래처마스터 DC_CD 로 잇는다 */ SELECT s.ITEM_CD, s.ITEM_NM, ISNULL(NULLIF(s.DLV_DT,''), s.OUT_DT), ISNULL(s.SALE_PRICE,0), ISNULL(s.OUT_QTY,0), N'정산서' FROM TBL_SALES_MST s CROSS APPLY ( SELECT CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_CD,'') <> '' THEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.DC_CD))) WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%용인%' THEN 'E100' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%왜관%' THEN 'E200' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%김해%' THEN 'E300' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%광주%' THEN 'E400' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%평택%' THEN 'E500' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%제주%' THEN 'E600' WHEN ISNULL(s.DC_NM,'') LIKE '%오산%' THEN 'E700' ELSE '' END AS dcKey ) dk WHERE s.ACTION_YN='Y' AND ISNULL(s.ITEM_CD,'') <> '' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR s.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ( ISNULL(#{srcFilter,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') IN ('','MST') ) AND dk.dcKey <> '' AND dk.dcKey IN ( SELECT DC_CD FROM TBL_VENDOR_MST WHERE ACTION_YN='Y' AND ISNULL(DC_CD,'') <> '' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) GROUP BY DC_CD HAVING MIN(VENDOR_CD) = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ISNULL(NULLIF(s.DLV_DT,''), s.OUT_DT) IS NOT NULL AND ( ISNULL(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR ISNULL(NULLIF(s.DLV_DT,''), s.OUT_DT) >= REPLACE(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') ) ) u ) x /* 상품마스터는 같은 코드가 여럿일 수 있어 최신 한 줄만 붙인다 */ OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 p2.PROD_SEQ, p2.PROD_NM, p2.SPEC, p2.MAKER_NM, p2.PACK_QTY, p2.TAX_GB FROM TBL_PROD_MST p2 WHERE p2.ACTION_YN='Y' AND p2.PROD_CD = x.prodCd AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR p2.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ORDER BY p2.PROD_SEQ DESC ) p /* 현재고 = 수불원장 집계. 재고현황(selectStockMstList)과 같은 식 */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT l.PROD_CD, SUM(CASE WHEN l.IO_GB IN ('I','R','A') THEN l.QTY WHEN l.IO_GB='O' THEN -l.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS curQty FROM TBL_STOCK_LEDGER l WHERE l.ACTION_YN='Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR l.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) GROUP BY l.PROD_CD ) st ON st.PROD_CD = x.prodCd WHERE x.rn = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_SALES_DLV_EXCL e WHERE e.ACTION_YN='Y' AND e.GB = 'S' AND e.CUST_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND e.PROD_CD = x.prodCd AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR e.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ) AND ( ISNULL(#{findData,jdbcType=NVARCHAR},'') = '' OR x.prodCd LIKE '%' + #{findData,jdbcType=NVARCHAR} + '%' OR ISNULL(p.PROD_NM, x.prodNm) LIKE '%' + #{findData,jdbcType=NVARCHAR} + '%' OR ISNULL(p.SPEC,'') LIKE '%' + #{findData,jdbcType=NVARCHAR} + '%' OR ISNULL(p.MAKER_NM,'') LIKE '%' + #{findData,jdbcType=NVARCHAR} + '%' ) ORDER BY x.lastDt DESC, x.prodCd

SELECT e.EXCL_SEQ AS exclSeq, e.CUST_CD AS custCd, e.PROD_CD AS prodCd, ISNULL(p.PROD_NM, e.PROD_NM) AS prodNm, ISNULL(p.SPEC,'') AS spec, ISNULL(p.MAKER_NM,'') AS makerNm, ISNULL(p.PACK_QTY,1) AS packQty, ISNULL(p.TAX_GB, N'과세') AS taxGb, p.PROD_SEQ AS prodSeq, ISNULL(p.SALE_PRICE,0) AS unitPrice, e.REASON AS reason, e.REG_DTTM AS regDttm, e.REG_USER AS regUser FROM TBL_SALES_DLV_EXCL e OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 p2.PROD_SEQ, p2.PROD_NM, p2.SPEC, p2.MAKER_NM, p2.PACK_QTY, p2.TAX_GB, p2.SALE_PRICE FROM TBL_PROD_MST p2 WHERE p2.ACTION_YN='Y' AND p2.PROD_CD = e.PROD_CD AND p2.COMP_CD = e.COMP_CD ORDER BY p2.PROD_SEQ DESC ) p WHERE e.ACTION_YN='Y' AND e.CUST_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND e.GB = ISNULL(#{gb,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'S') AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR e.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ( ISNULL(#{findData,jdbcType=NVARCHAR},'') = '' OR e.PROD_CD LIKE '%' + #{findData,jdbcType=NVARCHAR} + '%' OR ISNULL(p.PROD_NM, e.PROD_NM) LIKE '%' + #{findData,jdbcType=NVARCHAR} + '%' ) ORDER BY e.REG_DTTM DESC, e.PROD_CD
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_SALES_DLV_EXCL SET ACTION_YN = ISNULL(#{actionYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'Y'), -- 'Y' 제외 / 'N' 해제 PROD_NM = ISNULL(#{prodNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, PROD_NM), REASON = ISNULL(#{reason,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, REASON), UPD_DTTM = CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), GETDATE(), 120), UPD_USER = #{updUser,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, UPD_IP = #{updIp,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE CUST_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PROD_CD = #{prodCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND GB = ISNULL(#{gb,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'S') AND COMP_CD = ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'W1234567')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_SALES_DLV_EXCL (COMP_CD, GB, CUST_CD, PROD_CD, PROD_NM, REASON, ACTION_YN, REG_DTTM, REG_USER, REG_IP) VALUES (ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'W1234567'), ISNULL(#{gb,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'S'), #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{prodCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{prodNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{reason,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, 'Y', CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), GETDATE(), 120), #{regUser,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{regIp,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT x.prodCd AS prodCd, ISNULL(p.PROD_NM, x.prodNm) AS prodNm, ISNULL(p.SPEC, '') AS spec, ISNULL(p.MAKER_NM, '') AS makerNm, ISNULL(p.PACK_QTY, 1) AS packQty, ISNULL(p.TAX_GB, N'과세') AS taxGb, p.PROD_SEQ AS prodSeq, x.unitPrice AS unitPrice, x.qty AS qty, x.lastDt AS lastDt, x.cnt AS cnt, x.srcGb AS srcGb, ISNULL(st.curQty, 0) AS curQty FROM ( SELECT u.prodCd, u.prodNm, u.unitPrice, u.qty, u.srcGb, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.prodCd ORDER BY u.dt DESC, u.unitPrice DESC) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY u.prodCd) AS cnt, MAX(u.dt) OVER (PARTITION BY u.prodCd) AS lastDt FROM ( /* ① 매입전표 */ SELECT d.PROD_CD AS prodCd, d.PROD_NM AS prodNm, m.PURCH_DT AS dt, ISNULL(d.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS unitPrice, ISNULL(d.QTY,0) AS qty, N'전표' AS srcGb FROM TBL_PURCHASE_DTL d JOIN TBL_PURCHASE_MST m ON m.PURCH_SEQ = d.PURCH_SEQ AND m.ACTION_YN='Y' AND m.COMP_CD = d.COMP_CD WHERE d.ACTION_YN='Y' AND ISNULL(d.PROD_CD,'') <> '' AND m.VENDOR_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR d.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ( ISNULL(#{srcFilter,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') IN ('','TRX') ) AND ( ISNULL(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR m.PURCH_DT >= REPLACE(#{fromDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-','') ) UNION ALL /* ② 매입단가이력 — 상품관리에서 매입처별로 등록해 둔 단가 */ SELECT h.PROD_CD, N'', h.APPLY_DT, -- 품명은 아래 상품마스터에서 채운다 ISNULL(h.IN_PRICE,0), 0, N'단가이력' FROM TBL_PROD_INPRICE_HST h WHERE h.ACTION_YN='Y' AND ISNULL(h.PROD_CD,'') <> '' AND h.VENDOR_CD = #{custCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR h.COMP_CD = mapper.update: MERGE dbo.TBL_EXT_ITEM_MST AS t USING (SELECT ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'W1234567') AS COMP_CD, NULLIF(#{vendorCd,jdbcType=NVARCHAR},'') AS VENDOR_CD, #{extItemCd,jdbcType=NVARCHAR} AS EXT_ITEM_CD) AS s ON t.COMP_CD = s.COMP_CD AND ISNULL(t.VENDOR_CD,'') = ISNULL(s.VENDOR_CD,'') AND t.EXT_ITEM_CD = s.EXT_ITEM_CD AND t.ACTION_YN = 'Y' WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET VENDOR_NM = ISNULL(#{vendorNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, t.VENDOR_NM), EXT_ITEM_NM = ISNULL(#{extItemNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, t.EXT_ITEM_NM), EXT_SPEC = ISNULL(#{extSpec,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, t.EXT_SPEC), EXT_UNIT = ISNULL(#{extUnit,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, t.EXT_UNIT), EXT_PRICE = ISNULL(#{extPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, t.EXT_PRICE), TAX_GB = ISNULL(#{taxGb,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, t.TAX_GB), NOTI_DT = ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(ISNULL(#{notiDt,jdbcType=NVARCHAR},''),'-',''),''), t.NOTI_DT), STAT_GB = ISNULL(#{statGb,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, t.STAT_GB), UPD_DTTM = CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), GETDATE(), 120), UPD_USER = #{regUser,jdbcType=NVARCHAR} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (COMP_CD, VENDOR_CD, VENDOR_NM, EXT_ITEM_CD, EXT_ITEM_NM, EXT_SPEC, EXT_UNIT, EXT_PRICE, TAX_GB, NOTI_DT, STAT_GB, REMARK, ACTION_YN, REG_DTTM, REG_USER, REG_IP) VALUES (s.COMP_CD, s.VENDOR_CD, #{vendorNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, s.EXT_ITEM_CD, #{extItemNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{extSpec,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{extUnit,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{extPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{taxGb,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, REPLACE(ISNULL(#{notiDt,jdbcType=NVARCHAR},''),'-',''), #{statGb,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{remark,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, 'Y', CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), GETDATE(), 120), #{regUser,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{regIp,jdbcType=NVARCHAR});

SELECT p.PROD_SEQ AS prodSeq, p.PROD_CD AS prodCd, p.PROD_NM AS prodNm, ISNULL(p.SPEC,'') AS spec, ISNULL(p.TYPE_NM,'') AS typeNm, ISNULL(p.MAKER_NM,'') AS makerNm, CASE WHEN ISNULL(p.PACK_QTY,0) < 1 THEN 1 ELSE p.PACK_QTY END AS packQty, ISNULL(l.curQty,0) AS curQty, ISNULL(l.inQty,0) AS inQty, ISNULL(l.outQty,0) AS outQty, /* BOX·EA 분해 — 음수 재고도 부호를 지키도록 절대값으로 나눈 뒤 부호를 되돌린다 */ CASE WHEN ISNULL(l.curQty,0) < 0 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END * ( ABS(ISNULL(l.curQty,0)) / (CASE WHEN ISNULL(p.PACK_QTY,0) < 1 THEN 1 ELSE p.PACK_QTY END) ) AS boxQty, CASE WHEN ISNULL(l.curQty,0) < 0 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END * ( ABS(ISNULL(l.curQty,0)) % (CASE WHEN ISNULL(p.PACK_QTY,0) < 1 THEN 1 ELSE p.PACK_QTY END) ) AS eaQty FROM TBL_PROD_MST p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PROD_SEQ, SUM(CASE WHEN IO_GB IN ('I','R','A') THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS inQty, SUM(CASE WHEN IO_GB = 'O' THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS outQty, SUM(CASE WHEN IO_GB IN ('I','R','A') THEN QTY ELSE -QTY END) AS curQty FROM TBL_STOCK_LEDGER WHERE ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND ( ISNULL(#{asOfDt,jdbcType=NVARCHAR},'') = '' OR TRX_DT <= REPLACE(#{asOfDt,jdbcType=NVARCHAR},'-','') ) GROUP BY PROD_SEQ ) l ON l.PROD_SEQ = p.PROD_SEQ WHERE p.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR p.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
AND ( p.PROD_CD LIKE '%' + #{findData,jdbcType=NVARCHAR} + '%' OR p.PROD_NM LIKE '%' + #{findData,jdbcType=NVARCHAR} + '%' OR ISNULL(p.SPEC,'') LIKE '%' + #{findData,jdbcType=NVARCHAR} + '%' )
AND ISNULL(p.TYPE_NM,'') = #{typeNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}
AND ISNULL(p.MAKER_NM,'') = #{makerNm,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}
AND ISNULL(l.curQty,0) <> 0
ORDER BY
p.PROD_NM, p.PROD_CD ISNULL(l.curQty,0) DESC, p.PROD_CD p.PROD_CD
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_STOCK_ADJ_HIS (BATCH_NO, COMP_CD, PROD_SEQ, PROD_CD, BASE_DT, BEF_QTY, AFT_QTY, DIFF_QTY, BEF_BOX, BEF_EA, AFT_BOX, AFT_EA, PACK_QTY, LEDGER_SEQ, REMARK, ACTION_YN, REG_DTTM, REG_USER, REG_IP) VALUES (#{batchNo,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'W1234567'), #{prodSeq}, #{prodCd,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, REPLACE(ISNULL(#{baseDt,jdbcType=NVARCHAR},''),'-',''), #{befQty,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{aftQty,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{diffQty,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{befBox,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{befEa,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{aftBox,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{aftEa,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{packQty,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{ledgerSeq,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{remark,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, 'Y', CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), GETDATE(), 120), #{regUser,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{regIp,jdbcType=NVARCHAR})

SELECT h.ADJ_SEQ AS adjSeq, h.BATCH_NO AS batchNo, h.PROD_SEQ AS prodSeq, h.PROD_CD AS prodCd, ISNULL(p.PROD_NM,'') AS prodNm, ISNULL(p.SPEC,'') AS spec, h.BASE_DT AS baseDt, h.BEF_QTY AS befQty, h.AFT_QTY AS aftQty, h.DIFF_QTY AS diffQty, h.BEF_BOX AS befBox, h.BEF_EA AS befEa, h.AFT_BOX AS aftBox, h.AFT_EA AS aftEa, h.PACK_QTY AS packQty, h.LEDGER_SEQ AS ledgerSeq, h.REMARK AS remark, h.REG_DTTM AS regDttm, h.REG_USER AS regUser FROM TBL_STOCK_ADJ_HIS h LEFT JOIN TBL_PROD_MST p ON p.PROD_SEQ = h.PROD_SEQ AND p.COMP_CD = h.COMP_CD WHERE h.ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND ( ISNULL(#{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') = '' OR h.COMP_CD = #{compCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
AND h.PROD_SEQ = #{prodSeq}

AND h.BASE_DT <= REPLACE(#{dtTo,jdbcType=NVARCHAR},'-','')
